name: luismc-project-setup
description: Setting a project up to the organization's standards, one concern per skill. `tech-stack-setup` is a guided wizard that helps pick a coherent technology stack — language, frameworks, database, host and providers that work well together — then scaffolds a repository conforming to STACKSPEC 8.1.0, a technology-neutral invariants spec, or audits an existing repo against it. The generated repository carries a branch gate with a verifiable result and the delivery scripts that go with it. `auth-setup` then builds the authentication and authorization stack to the binding AUTHSPEC, and refuses to run until the first has. `claude-setup` applies the Claude Code configuration to the project and/or ~/.claude/. One sets up the repo, one sets up auth in it, one sets up the agent working on it.
